title: After the Central restart DL560 stays unverified with localInstallFailed and retries in backoff
outcome: After a Central restart DL560 re-authenticates like the Mac and Windows B, or the reason it cannot is identified and fixed.
acceptance: The failing local install step for DL560 (host e83d08f4) is identified with its quoted error or log line and the code path, and classified as a DL560-side state, a central defect or expected behaviour.
A defect gets a fix with a regression test and a clean review pair, and DL560 reaches authenticated after a Central restart.
